SUBSTRATUM.Name: Name
SUBSTRATUM.TeamDeathHeadline: A member of the Team has died.
SUBSTRATUM.ActionConvinceBad: Opposite/hostile reaction — forced into a Confront or Avoid Action.
SUBSTRATUM.ActionPrepareOk: A flaw or delay complicates it.
SUBSTRATUM.ActionPrepareBad: Fails catastrophically — forced into a Confront or Avoid Action.
SUBSTRATUM.ActionStudyGood: Learn something, and gain 1 Anomaly Clue.
SUBSTRATUM.ActionStudyOk: Learn something with gaps — the MC may twist it later.
SUBSTRATUM.ActionTravelGood: Reach the next Depth Sector — everyone clears 2 Stress and fully resets their Skills.
SUBSTRATUM.ActionTravelOk: Arrive, but it's hard — clear 1 Stress, complication on arrival.
SUBSTRATUM.ActionTravelBad: A treacherous journey — mark 1 Stress, new complication.
SUBSTRATUM.ActionUnderstandGood: Convert an Anomaly Clue into permanent Anomaly Knowledge.
SUBSTRATUM.ActionUnderstandOk: Close but not quite — Flashback and reroll, or mark 1 Stress if there's no card or it's a second attempt.
SUBSTRATUM.ActionUnderstandBad: Discard the Clue, or mark 2 Stress to give it to someone else.
SUBSTRATUM.ActionUnderstandAutoSuccess: Beyond the Horizon — UNDERSTAND automatically succeeds. No roll, no cards drawn.
SUBSTRATUM.WarnPickTwoSkills: Pick two different Skills before rolling.
SUBSTRATUM.WarnItemOverclockConflict: Can't Overclock a Skill slot that's using an item instead.
SUBSTRATUM.DeepBreathFullReset: All Skills reset to their max die.
SUBSTRATUM.DeepBreathPartialReset: Beyond the Horizon — Skills only step up 1 step (not a full reset).
SUBSTRATUM.DeepBreathComplication: The MC introduces a new complication.
SUBSTRATUM.OverclockUnavailable: Overclock already used — take a Deep Breath to refresh it.
SUBSTRATUM.OverclockStressMark: Max die already at d4 — marked +{amount} Stress instead.
SUBSTRATUM.WarnOverclockBothSkills: Only one Skill can be Overclocked per Check.
SUBSTRATUM.WarnOverclockUnavailable: Overclock has already been used since the last Deep Breath.
SUBSTRATUM.ExosuitNoCards: No cards collected yet — beat a card during a Skill Check to add it to your hand.
SUBSTRATUM.ExosuitRepairHealHint: Discard 2 cards: clear 1 Stress, or repair an item back to its max die.
SUBSTRATUM.ExosuitBoostActionsHint: Before a Skill Check, discard 2 same-suit cards to add +1 to the result. Stacks per extra 2 cards.
SUBSTRATUM.Exosuit3DPrinterHint: Lay down cards vs MC, up to your hand max. Each win makes the printed item more powerful.
SUBSTRATUM.ExosuitComplication: The item arrives with a complication.
SUBSTRATUM.ExosuitRadioHint: Lay 1 card vs MC to ask Mission Control a question.
SUBSTRATUM.RadioWin: Mission Control hears you — a conversation begins.
SUBSTRATUM.RadioLose: The connection is garbled. Only a few words come through.
SUBSTRATUM.ExosuitSensorDeploymentHint: Lay 1 card vs MC. Your stated answer about the scene becomes canon.
SUBSTRATUM.ExosuitFlashbackHint: Lay 1 card vs MC. Win for advantage, lose for disadvantage on your next Skill Check.
SUBSTRATUM.FlashbackWin: Describe the flashback — advantage on your next Skill Check.
SUBSTRATUM.FlashbackLose: Describe a negative flashback — disadvantage on your next Skill Check.
SUBSTRATUM.ExosuitSystemsUpgradeHint: Discard 8 cards: clear all Stress, +1 Stress capacity, reset all Skills to max, +1 step to one Skill's max die.
SUBSTRATUM.WarnPickTwoCards: Select exactly 2 cards from your hand.
SUBSTRATUM.WarnPickEvenCards: Select an even number of cards (2 or more), all the same suit.
SUBSTRATUM.WarnPickSameSuit: Selected cards must all be the same suit.
SUBSTRATUM.WarnPickAtLeastOneCard: Select at least 1 card from your hand.
SUBSTRATUM.WarnPickOneCard: Select exactly 1 card from your hand.
SUBSTRATUM.WarnPickEightCards: Select exactly 8 cards from your hand.
SUBSTRATUM.WarnRepairInvalidTarget: That target can't be repaired right now — pick Stress above 0 or an item below its max die.
